product_summary: Rexel India Pvt Ltd is the Indian arm of the French Rexel group, listed on the group's own worldwide-presence page (rexel.com/en/worldwide-presence/) with webshop rexel.co.in. Group self-description (rexel.com/en/what-we-do/, rexel.com/en/industrial/): 'a leading distributor of electrical products, services and solutions for the industrial, commercial and residential markets' — electrical supplies, industrial control, automation and specialty products, lighting/LED retrofit, cable cutting, logistics and MRO supply. No valves, fittings, taps or fluid-handling hardware appear anywhere in the published product/service description. The Indian site rexel.co.in could not be opened (timeout / TLS hostname mismatch on www.rexel.co.in), so the India-specific catalogue and any HS lines are unverified.
role_hint: trader (distributor/reseller of third-party electrical brands; group explicitly positions itself as a distributor, not a manufacturer)
comment: HS 848180 (taps, cocks, valves and similar appliances for pipes/boilers) does not correspond to the documented business: Rexel is an electrical-equipment distributor. Industry claim 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas / chemicals) is a misclassification — the correct industry is electrical wholesale/distribution (electrical products for industrial, commercial and residential markets), with oil & gas at most an end-customer vertical. Per project rule 3 the company is NOT rejected on HS grounds: keep it in the base and correct the code to the actual electrical lines (8536/8537/8544/8539-9405 as primary). Trader signs: group-level self-description as distributor, 1,975+ branches, supplier-partner procurement model, no own manufacturing stated. Product lines missing from the declaration: wiring/cable, switchgear and protection devices, distribution boards and panels, lighting/LED, industrial control and automation, tools and MRO consumables, plus services (cable cutting, 3PL, equipment rental). All of the above is company self-description on rexel.com — status: 'заявлено, не подтверждено' (no customs line or India-specific catalogue page was retrievable within this check; rexel.co.in unreachable). No registry, revenue or shipment data researched per role scope.
